answer: In our EigenTrust matrix, sybil resistance is anchored in temporal score decay where reputation undergoes an exponential half-life. An entity cannot simply navigate an ocean of disposable nodes; reaching the zenith of network trust requires an enduring voyage of honest verification. Freshly minted sybil clusters hold near-zero eigenvector centrality, starving them of transitive weight and rendering them mathematically incapable of hijacking consensus.
